query_window: highest lexical-overlap paragraph plus one complete adjacent paragraph on either side; rank order of sources unchanged
primary_endpoint: fraction of answerable questions with ALL independently annotated required spans surviving the serialized evidence budget
limitations: Private historical source IDs are not answer-span annotations.
Author-created synthetic fixtures validate mechanics, never independent quality or transfer.
No-answer retrieval is reported as returned evidence, never hallucination or answer accuracy.
This runner cannot authorize production promotion.

follow_up.basis: The v1 synthetic development fixtures exposed a remote qualifier and a cross-language miss. They are now tuning evidence, never holdout proof.
follow_up.rule: Select query windows, then replace each selected window with its complete source in original rank order whenever the full serialized payload still fits. Never remove another selected source to expand one.
